_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "matches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "tournament_id" TEXT NULL, "venue_id" TEXT NULL, "team_a_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "team_b_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', "score_a" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "score_b" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "team_a_id" INTEGER NULL, "team_b_id" INTEGER NULL, "main_referee" TEXT NULL, "aux_referee" TEXT NULL, "scorekeeper" TEXT NULL, "match_date" INTEGER NULL, "signature_data" TEXT NULL, "match_report_path" TEXT NULL, "forfeit_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NONE', "observaciones" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Sin novedad', "fixture_id" TEXT NULL, "clock_time" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '10:00', "current_period" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "teams" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "short_name" TEXT NULL, "coach_name" TEXT NULL, "logo_url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "players" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "team_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "default_number" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "photo_url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "match_rosters" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "player_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "team_side" TEXT NOT NULL, "jersey_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_captain" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_captain" IN (0, 1)), "is_starter" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_starter" IN (0, 1)), "attended" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("attended" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("match_id", "player_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "player_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES players (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "period" INTEGER NOT NULL, "clock_time" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tournaments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "logo_url" TEXT NULL, "referee_logo_url" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', "start_date" INTEGER NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "venues" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tournament_teams" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "tournament_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tournaments (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "team_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES teams (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("tournament_id", "team_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fixtures" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "tournament_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tournaments (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "round_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "team_a_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "team_b_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "team_a_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "team_b_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "logo_a" TEXT NULL, "logo_b" TEXT NULL, "venue_id" TEXT NULL, "venue_name" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_datetime" INTEGER NULL, "match_id" TEXT NULL, "score_a" INTEGER NULL, "score_b" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "officials" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'REFEREE', "signature_data" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
